On Saturday, in a post on
, O’Leary described Musk as someone who dedicates nearly all his waking hours to what matters, saying, "When I look at Elon Musk, I see almost 100% signal and no noise."
Sharing a clip of himself discussing Musk, O’Leary emphasized the
CEO’s ability to stay focused throughout the day.
"He does not deal with noise. He is 100% signal 24 seconds, you know, every cycle," he said.
He added, "The guy is just 60 seconds of every minute, 60 minutes of every hour. The 18 hours he’s awake, it’s all signal."
O’Leary pointed to Musk’s accomplishments as evidence of the effectiveness of this approach while acknowledging its potential personal costs.
"Now, that’s very awkward for him socially," he said, explaining that distractions could include spending time with family, greeting friends, playing the guitar or scrolling through social media.
He added that history’s greatest achievers often shared a similar ability to concentrate on their missions, saying that "the geniuses of their time were close to 100% signal."
